reclaim_stages.name: registry_cleanup
reclaim_stages.description: The host janitor runs one pass of the disk-full rule: at 80% used it deletes everything every cleaner finds; below it, nothing.
reclaim_stages.roots_from: the janitor's cleaners, each in its own fleet-owned area

reclaim_stages.name: build_scratch
reclaim_stages.description: Stale release-build work beneath $HOME/.stado/build-work; a tree a launchd or systemd unit on the host names is a service's program and is kept.

reclaim_stages.name: queue_workdirs
reclaim_stages.description: Terminal queue work trees proved unused by the queue authority or conservative local evidence.
reclaim_stages.roots_from: the account's own temporary container, as the operating system reports it

reclaim_stages.name: foreign_home_trees
reclaim_stages.description: macOS-style /Users trees left on Linux hosts.

reclaim_stages.name: delivered_trees
reclaim_stages.description: Stale product versions under the service root and product-catalog superseded roots.

reclaim_stages.name: delivery_leftovers
reclaim_stages.description: Attestation copies and retained archives of delivered versions other than the installed and newest ones, and the binary copies an install leaves beside each installed binary under ~/.stado/bin: <name>.release-backup-<stamp>, <name>.<version>-backup-<stamp>, <name>.bak-<stamp> and <name>.pre-<label>, all but the newest of them. <name>.previous is the rollback target of the binary installed now and is never taken; a copy whose shape this stage does not recognise is named in the preview and retained.

reclaim_stages.name: rebuildable_caches
reclaim_stages.description: Declared product-owned package, browser, probe, download, and build caches.

reclaim_stages.name: tagged_build_caches
reclaim_stages.description: Directories carrying a build tool's own CACHEDIR.TAG anywhere under the home, the scope of the janitor's build_caches cleaner. What that cleaner cannot reach on a Mac, because the folders are protected and the agent holds no Full Disk Access grant.

reclaim_stages.name: chromium_clones
reclaim_stages.roots_from: the account's own temporary container, as macOS reports it

reclaim_stages.name: local_apfs_snapshots
reclaim_stages.description: Every local Time Machine APFS snapshot; the operating system's update snapshots are never listed as Time Machine snapshots and stay.
reclaim_stages.roots_from: tmutil listlocalsnapshots, which occupies no path a du walk can attribute

reclaim_stages.name: runner_work_trees
reclaim_stages.description: Inactive GitHub runner _work trees outside runner bookkeeping directories.
